calculation.description: For each tradable asset, negate its 3-trading-day return in excess of the previous day's equal-weight mean 3-day return across the 15-asset universe. Higher values indicate stronger idiosyncratic short-term reversal. The peer mean is lagged one day for online causality.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC remained positive in 2020-2022 (0.053835), 2023-2024 (0.041481), and 2025-2027 (0.027222); recent regime is weaker but above the daily admission threshold. Small cross-asset universe implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
